items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: and Ray Conniff was on trombone.

ctx.x: Well, did you meet any of the guys? Who was in the band with you?

Well, when I joined -- this is '33 when we went on the road -- Jimmy Blake, and he's passed away since then, he used to be with Tommy Dorsey; a fine trumpet player. He was about 17 or 18 years old, and Ray Conniff was on trombone. Now he never had a long pair of pants, and we used to wear naval uniforms -- we were the skippers, and we bought them in Charleston, Boston -- Charlestown in Boston, and they had the regular uniforms, we had the white starched uniforms that they still use at the naval academy with the…
And Ray Conniff never had a long pair of pants. He was only about 15 or 16 -- I may be off a year or two here, but he was about 15 or 16. [Pause]
